title: aPrivateMessages
description: A mod that adds private messages
body:
# Info

**Works on server side**

# Commands:

- **/pm [player] [message]**
- **/msg [player] [message]**
- **/m [player] [message]**
- **/tell [player] [message]**

# Languages 
**English** - en_us.json 

**Russia** - ru_ru.json 

**France** - fr_fr.json 

**Deutsche** - de_de.json 

**Belarus** - be_by.json
